item.title: Harvey Weinstein accuser Kaja Sokola is being sued for defamation. The plaintiff: Her sister
item.description: Two sisters testified at Harvey Weinstein's most recent criminal trial. Kaja Sokola accused the disgraced movie mogul of sexual assault. Ewa Sokola was called as a witness to boost her claims, but ultimately ended up helping the defense.

item.title: 4 weather-related deaths in California, as intense storms turn some roads into rivers of mud
item.description: Heavy rains and strong winds from powerful winter storms this week brought the wettest Christmas season to Southern California in years, triggering widespread mudslides and debris flows and leaving homes halfway filled with mud.

item.title: What to know about the militants targeted by US airstrikes in northwest Nigeria
item.description: The airstrikes targeting militants affiliated with the Islamic State in northwestern Nigeria are a major escalation of an offensive that Nigeria's overstretched military has struggled with for years.

item.title: Perry Bamonte, guitarist and keyboardist for The Cure, dies at 65
item.description: Perry Archangelo Bamonte, longtime guitarist and keyboardist for the influential goth band The Cure, has died, the band announced on Friday. He was 65.

item.title: Zelenskyy says he will meet with Trump in Florida on Sunday for talks on Ukraine security guarantees
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Friday that he will meet over the weekend with U.S. President Donald Trump in Florida.

item.title: Times Square to feature patriotic celebration for New Year's Eve and a special ball drop in July
item.description: It will mark the first time in 120 years there will be ball drop in Times Square that doesn't occur on New Year's Eve.

item.title: 'A lot to be grateful for': Follow-up with East Bay couple after SNAP benefits restored
item.description: ABC7 News caught up with an East Bay couple who were among the millions of people cut off from their SNAP benefits during the government shutdown.

item.title: Avalanche leaves 2 ski patrollers injured at Mammoth Mountain
item.description: Two ski patrollers were injured in an avalanche at Mammoth Mountain Friday morning while they were performing mitigation work.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Calm, clear, chilly conditions return overnight
item.description: The atmospheric river is winding down. Calm and clear conditions will allow for radiational cooling and thus cold overnight conditions to return.
